text:
maria: kicking off a staged rollout for v2026.3 now — targeting 5% global traffic, EU + AP first. deploy-bot will post updates.

deploy-bot: [deploy] start rollout v2026.3 -> 5% traffic (eu-west-1, ap-south-1). changes: model swap + KV cache tweak. CI: passed. ETA to 25%: ~15m if no signal.

ben: seeing a small uptick in embed latency in eu-west at the 2m mark, +40ms p95. not huge yet but flagging.

carla: any 5xxs?

ben: only a handful, ~0.05% but clustered to a single host pool. logs show `kvcache-miss` spikes. attaching snippet shortly.

ops-bot: metric alert: eu-west embed_p95 latency > baseline by 35ms for 3m (:warning:).

maria: OK hold for now. @deploy-bot pause rollout. do not advance to 25%.

deploy-bot: acknowledged. pausing rollout at 5%. no further traffic shift.

carla: can we pin requests from EU to the previous version while we triage? we should avoid full rollback if we can isolate by region.

maria: good call. sanjay, can you kick a region pin for eu-west to v2026.2? small change, low blast.

sanjay: on it. running `redwoodctl route pin --region eu-west-1 --from v2026.3 --to v2026.2 --duration 30m`

sanjay: pinned eu-west to v2026.2. verifying traffic shift... now at ~98% eu-west on v2026.2.

ben: latency in eu-west dropped back to baseline after pin. the 5xx cluster cooled off. initial root cause looks like a kvcache eviction pattern with the new model's tokenization size.

maria: nice. what's status in ap-south? the rollout included that region too.

ben: ap-south still at 5% and stable. no latency change there.

carla: proposal: keep rollout paused globally, keep eu pinned to v2026.2, spin a small test job that simulates EU prefix distribution against v2026.3 with higher KV budget. if passes, we can try a hotfix that tweaks cache sizing and resume.

maria: agreed. @sanjay please spin the synthetic test and add a short runbook item to the release notes: `rollback-eu-if-kvcache>0.03%` for future.

sanjay: creating test job: `jobs/run-sim --config tests/eu-prefix-load.yaml --image v2026.3`

ops-bot: test job started (id: tj-4592). ETA 8m.

maria: thanks everyone. current plan: pause rollout, pin eu-west to v2026.2, run synthetic test, iterate on cache config. no full rollback for now. I'll open a release-note patch and tag infra/release for visibility.

carla: adding a short postmortem note if we end up rolling back. keeping stakeholders copied. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: final state: rollout paused at 5%. regions: eu-west pinned to v2026.2, ap-south remains v2026.3 at 5%.

maria: if tests are green in 20m and no further signals, we can reconvene and decide advance -> 25% or deploy cache fix. meeting @ 16:45 for go/no-go.

ben: copying logs to #incidents incase needed.

sanjay: test results: initial run shows stable KV hit rate after bumping cache by +15%. will run two more iterations.

maria: ack. will wait for two clean runs before we talk about resuming. thanks all.
